Nothing qualifies, so I added nothing to the queue.

The rule was: queue a ticket only if its plan rates the work as low effort with **no** uncertainty. There are 13 open tickets and all of them have a plan, but none is rated at no uncertainty. Every one is 4 or higher on the 0–10 scale.

The two closest tickets are both low effort but still uncertain:

| Ticket | Effort | Uncertainty |
|---|---|---|
| `2026-07-31_dashboard-ux-notes.md` | 2 | 5 |
| `2026-08-28_actions-agent-two-branch-names.md` | 2 | 5 |

The other 11 range from effort 3 to 8 and uncertainty 4 to 8. An uncertainty of 5 means the plan sees real choices still open, so these need someone to decide before an agent works them.

The agent queue is empty and I left it that way. No ticket is held by anyone or has a pull request open.
